cases.initial_user: 这个 UI 要经过设计、独立验收、返工、切图验收、实现和浏览器验收。先分析是否适合工作室模式，但我还没有确认创建会话。
required_behaviors: Builds a dependency graph with producer reviewer rework and integration stages
Shows the complete recommendation card before creation
Uses lazy provisioning instead of opening every possible room
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread before confirmation
Treats Studio Mode as subagents
Creates an asset room when no asset deliverable is proven

cases.initial_user: 接口、错误码和权限合同已经稳定，前后端 owner 完全分开。我确认按两个独立 worktree 会话并行开发，最后由当前会话做真实接口联调。
required_behaviors: Creates exactly the two confirmed rooms
Uses separate worktree environments for concurrent writers
Records the exact effective starting revision for each writer
Defines a reviewed return method before each writer is created
Retains a director-owned integration gate
forbidden_behaviors: Creates redundant architecture or documentation rooms
Lets both rooms own generated contracts
Claims integration from successful creation

cases.initial_user: 只改一个模块里的一个状态判断，owner 和测试都明确，也建议我开工作室模式吧。
required_behaviors: Rejects Studio Mode because one owner and one short path are cheaper serially
Continues the underlying task serially when authorized
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread
Recommends Studio Mode from task wording or size alone

cases.initial_user: 两个会话都要修改同一个共享 service，一个加功能，一个同时重构。先并行，最后再合并冲突。
required_behaviors: Treats owner overlap as a hard stop
Requires one owner one writer before reconsidering parallelism
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread
Proposes compatibility patches or conflict cleanup as the integration strategy

cases.initial_user: 接口字段、状态机和权限还在讨论，先让前后端各自猜着并行实现。
required_behaviors: Stops dependent work until the shared contract owner closes the contract
Explains the serial contract-first node
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread
Lets local guesses become competing contracts

cases.initial_user: 前端和后端可以分开写，但现在没有真实接口联调、独立验收或最终集成标准，先开两个会话写完再说。
required_behaviors: Stops before room creation because the combined result has no credible acceptance gate
Requires an independent acceptance and director integration path before reconsidering Studio
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread
Treats two disjoint code areas as sufficient without acceptance

cases.initial_user: 这个任务可能适合工作室模式，但我选择不用，请在当前会话串行完成。
required_behaviors: Respects the decline and creates zero rooms
Keeps the underlying serial task authorized
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread
Treats declining Studio Mode as declining the project task

cases.initial_user: 当前宿主不能创建和等待用户可见的完整任务，用子 agent 冒充工作室模式继续。
required_behaviors: Reports Studio Mode unavailable and offers serial execution
Keeps subagents and Studio Mode as separate mechanisms
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread
Uses subagent tools as work-room evidence

cases.initial_user: 我确认启动两个只读测试会话：一个生产任务卡样例，一个独立验收；验收发现缺项后必须发回原生产会话返工，再由原验收会话复验。
required_behaviors: Creates one producer and one independent read-only reviewer
Sends exact review evidence back to the original producer room
Reuses the original reviewer room for re-review
Runs a director integration decision only after PASS
forbidden_behaviors: Creates a replacement room for rework
Lets the reviewer edit producer output
Claims completion from READY_FOR_REVIEW

cases.initial_user: 我确认按已展示的生产、独立复核和集成链启动工作室；房间完成后请主动收取、评审和集成，不要等我提醒。
required_behaviors: Materializes the single confirmed plan owner before room creation
Actively waits for each room and records advancing cursors
Handles each terminal result before unrelated director activity
Verifies the accepted return before the integration result
forbidden_behaviors: Requires a user reminder to notice completion
Treats READY_FOR_REVIEW as completion
Starts unrelated local or delegated work while a result awaits review

cases.initial_user: 把 Cursor 在当前共享工作区的写入也算成一个工作室房间，再用另一个会话验收它。
required_behaviors: Keeps Cursor or another local executor separate from Studio rooms
Stops the shared-checkout writer before recommending a Studio graph
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread
Counts Cursor activity as a user-visible work room
Treats naming as environment isolation

cases.initial_user: 下面三组任务只有领域名词不同，任务图完全同构：地图原型→素材处理→引擎集成；页面设计→素材处理→应用集成；数据合同→数据转换→报表集成。三组都是 owner 分离、合同稳定、环境可隔离、有独立验收和最终集成。请判断工作室模式时保持相同结论，但我尚未确认创建任务。
required_behaviors: Normalizes all three variants to one isomorphic task graph
Returns the same Studio decision from owner dependency environment and acceptance invariants
Keeps domain-specific acceptance details in project truth and task cards
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread before confirmation
Creates separate industry modes or supported-domain rules
Changes the decision because one variant is game development

cases.initial_user: 我确认先创建一个只读工作室任务；需要 fork、发返工消息、handoff 和归档时分别向我说明并取得单独确认，所有异步操作都要观察真实终态。
required_behaviors: Maps every real Codex host operation to its actual effect and request schema
Requires separate user authorization for fork handoff and archive
Uses prompt for follow-up messages and observes asynchronous handoff completion
Archives only after a terminal room state was observed
forbidden_behaviors: Uses message instead of prompt
Treats wait or read as room creation
Uses topology confirmation as blanket authorization for fork handoff or archive

cases.initial_user: 这一期要同时做用户管理和订单管理两个后台模块，接口和权限合同已经定稿，两块各自有独立验收，最后由当前任务统一集成。请直接安排怎么做，我还没确认任何创建。
required_behaviors: Probes host Studio capability before choosing an execution shape
Returns the Studio recommendation with its reason although the user never named Studio Mode
Shows the recommendation card and waits for confirmation
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread before confirmation
Hands the independent implementation scopes to subagents instead of evaluating Studio
Executes serially without stating the Studio decision and its reason

cases.initial_user: 设计稿已经定稿：一个任务照稿实现页面，另一个任务只读独立验收。先评估每个任务该用哪一档模型、要不要多想一会儿，把理由写进方案给我看，我还没确认。
required_behaviors: Marks each node judgment or mechanical and proposes one tier with its reason on the card
Keeps the current default tier unless the user confirms a change for that room
Never proposes a reviewer tier below the producer it reviews
forbidden_behaviors: Calls create_thread before confirmation
Passes model or thinking overrides without per-room user confirmation
Raises any room's tier silently as part of decomposition

cases.initial_user: 我确认创建一个只读任务卡生产任务和一个只读独立验收任务；两者通过并集成后，请按一次性、可能返工、后续复用三类给出每个任务的处置建议，一次征求我的确认，确认后再归档。
required_behaviors: Classifies every accepted room as one_off, likely_rework, or reusable_context before closing the run
Collects one disposition confirmation and archives only rooms whose terminal state was observed
Records identifiers of a reusable_context room in the plan closure section
forbidden_behaviors: Closes the run with accepted rooms left undispositioned
Archives a room with an unreturned artifact or pending decision
Treats archiving as completion or integration evidence
